_comment: P41b (card t_1b28a273; docs/CONCEPT_massive_interior_v1.md v1.3 sections 4-D1/D2/D6, 5-H2, 9.4) - interior law for Massive figures, HAND-PINNED ground truth (NOT --record; same route as tracker_bind.json/duty_loader.json - no RNG, no Python sim twin). Canonical vectors come OUT of the H1 census (docs/MASSIVE_interior_census.md + tools/massive_interior_crosswalk_candidates.json, real missions/rows); hand-written vectors only for edges (section edges, synthetic signed rows). Every expectation was hand-derived from the RR enumeration (19A-36A/19B-36B interior; 38A/38B/39A/39B exterior; keyed Core expansion only) plus the crosswalk law (unsigned/missing row = Ambiguous, D2 fail-open at the consumer WITH the forensic line, mapping verification fail-CLOSED). tiles: tile-level law + forensic reason. rows: the Thomas-signature path (no shipped row is signed yet - these vectors pin what a signature DOES, incl. the fail-closed biome-drift law). sections: the four-state derivation - the four CORE4 sections are the REAL authored map (GUIDs 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 / 11932fb9-a2aa-4ffc-901c-a5f44391857d / f3a7cacd-a2af-4a3d-8ea5-fbe24b3c4cf6 / b81a7731-254d-4c36-9d83-a04b045e480f): Start Section is the pure-interior room the CORE4 authored indoor Massive (General Weiss + Hijacked AT-ST on Core19A) sits in - the D6 override case; the four states all appear on one real map. overrides: D6 registration from authored rows - CORE4/CORE11/JABBA9 rows are the census section-6 list (multi-event respawn = set semantics; the fail-closed case: an authored DP resolving Ambiguous registers NOTHING). mask: NotBanned node filter incl. the fail-open probe on an unknown section. seal: D3-A seal-the-approach BFS, hand-written edges: Open-only targets, Ambiguous traversable but never a target, Banned never a route, tie law = nearest layer then ordinal-smallest id.

tiles.name: core19A_rr_interior
tiles._why: census section 2/3: the A-side label is Imperial but the RR pins BOTH sides interior - the enumeration beats the label

tiles.name: core36B_rr_interior_end
tiles._why: last id of the enumerated 19..36 range

tiles.name: core18A_just_below_unsigned
tiles._why: core 1..18 carry NO law row (census: pinned UNKNOWN, candidate OPEN unsigned) - unresolved, fail-open at the consumer, never silently

tiles.name: core38A_rr_exterior
tiles._why: RR names 38A/38B/39A/39B exterior - None is not interior evidence either (census section 2)

tiles.name: core20A_pin_survives_biome_drift
tiles._why: a drifted biome argument cannot un-pin an ENUMERATED tile - the pin is physical-tile property, the label is evidence only (the drift check guards signed rows, see rows[])

tiles.name: hoth19A_overlap_guard
tiles._why: spec section 7 THE error class: Hoth 19 NUMERICALLY overlaps the RR interior range but is a different physical tile - a bare id rule would wrongly ban it

tiles.name: hoth1B_interior_candidate_not_law
tiles._why: census candidate BANNED_CANDIDATE (Interior biome) - a machine guess is never a BANNED row (D2); it stays law-free until signed

tiles.name: bespin1A_halls_class
tiles._why: the Halls-class ambiguity (Bespin/Empire halls) - exactly the rows section 7 says only a rulebook signature can close

tiles.name: empire1B_open_candidate_unsigned
tiles._why: even the OPEN candidate is unsigned - no signed row, no law status; the runtime still plays it (fail-open), with the forensic line

tiles.name: core99A_no_row
tiles._why: a tile with no crosswalk row at all is unresolved, never a silent Open-without-log

tiles.name: core20_sideC_pin_covers_both_sides
tiles._why: the RR pin is keyed (expansion, tileID) and covers BOTH sides (19A-36A and 19B-36B) - a non-A side string, read as B by the GetBiomeType law, is still pinned

rows.name: signed_hoth1b_becomes_law
rows._why: what a Thomas signature DOES: the Hoth Interior-biome row turns from evidence into law (H1's per-row pinning product)

rows.name: signed_ambiguous_stays_unresolved
rows._why: a signature may also KEEP a row unresolved (Thomas rules the row, incl. the open decision)

rows.name: signed_row_biome_drifts_fail_closed
rows._why: D2 mapping verification stays fail-CLOSED: the signature covers the row it was given for - a placement whose biome drifted from the signed row never inherits the signed status

rows.name: bogus_ruling_fails_closed
rows._why: a signature that is not a status word is a data bug - it resolves unresolved, never a silent ban

rows.name: rr_row_via_row_api
rows._why: the enumeration short-circuits the row reading - RR rows need no signature (census: 'RR law (no signature needed)')

sections.name: core4_start_section
sections._why: REAL CORE4 map: every tile RR-interior -> a pure-interior section, a real hole in the Massive graph (D1); this is the room the authored indoor Massive (General Weiss on Core19A per the CORE4 pointList, census section 6) starts in - the case the D6 override law exists for

sections.name: core4_hangar
sections._why: Banned + unresolved (core 37 carries no law row) -> the census sec_state tie: mixed-with-unknown is MIXED, and the unresolved tile still owes its [interior] ambigious-tile forensic line

sections.name: core4_warehouse
sections._why: interior tiles and exterior tiles share the section - THE common street-plus-room case (D1 MIXED: traversable, stay-out reminder on the order, never a section ban)

sections.name: core4_clearing
sections._why: every tile is unsigned core outdoor (candidate OPEN, pinned UNKNOWN) - nothing resolves, so the SECTION is AMBIGUOUS: open by D2 policy (fail-open), never silently (forensic true)

sections.name: hand_no_tiles
sections._why: a section with no tile under it is unresolved by the D1 derivation law, never silently OPEN (census section 4 note; the fleet measures 7 such sections)

overrides.name: core4_authored_indoor
overrides._why: census section 6, the shipped override_candidate rows verbatim (event6 authored General Weiss on Core19A; event21 custom 'Hijacked AT-ST' on Core19A). Core19A is RR-pinned -> VERIFIED-BANNED -> both cards lift for the mission. The AT-ST probe pins card-scoping: the custom card name lifts nothing else, not even by substring

overrides.name: core11_authored_outdoor_candidate_unverified
overrides._why: the census lists this authored DP 'outdoor - no override needed' under the CANDIDATE view (core 2A reads OPEN) - but the row is UNSIGNED, so the runtime status is Ambiguous and D6 v1.3 fail-closed registers NOTHING (an override that lifted the ban everywhere must never ride an unverified mapping row, spec 9.2: Ambiguous -> override_unverified log, ban stays)

overrides.name: jabba9_rancor_halls_class_unverified
overrides._why: census row JABBA9/4edd59 (DP tile Jabba3B, candidate AMBIGUOUS): the authored placement sits on an unsigned Halls-class row - the ban stays until the row is signed (override_unverified)

overrides.name: multi_event_respawn_idempotent
overrides._why: D6 multi-event respawn (spec 9.4 'multi-event respawn case'): throne-room guards re-deployed by a later Specific event hit the same BANNED ground again; set semantics keep ONE registration - derived-not-stored means re-derivation is idempotent (deterministic replay, D5). covered==[AT-ST] pins the count

overrides.name: outdoor_authored_nothing_to_lift
overrides._why: authored DP on RR-exterior ground: no ban applies, nothing registers (hand-written edge - no shipped authored row lands on a pinned-Open tile, census section 6 confirms)

mask.name: core4_view
mask._why: the CORE4 four-state view through the Massive node filter: only the pure-interior Start Section is a hole; MIXED is legal ground (stay-out reminder rides the order); AMBIGUOUS passes FAIL-OPEN (D2 - the caller owes the forensic line); a section missing from the map passes like Ambiguous, never silently

mask.name: empty_map_fails_open
mask._why: Null-Law direction at the Core seam: no derived map (no biome/tile data) -> the filter lets every node through, so consumers degrade to today's canon exactly (D4); the [interior] log line is the Unity side's duty

seal.name: mixed_is_not_a_target
seal._why: MIXED is traversable ground but the seal holds verified OPEN ground (spec 9.1 'nearest Open neighbour'); the printed rule, not a hiding of it (D3-A)

seal.name: ambiguous_traversable_not_target
seal._why: fail-open ground can be crossed but never carries the seal - the order states open facts

seal.name: hole_is_never_a_route
seal._why: the only path runs through another Banned section - interior holes are facts, not permeable belief (D3-A: the permeability law is HERO belief, never map law); honest null, never a chase

seal.name: tie_ordinal_smallest_wins
seal._why: fixed tie law (spec 9.4 'seal BFS tie law'): same layer -> ordinal-smallest id; the authored edge list order is deliberately the WRONG order to prove the sort governs

seal.name: detour_around_the_wall
seal._why: BFS walks past a dead-end hole into the fail-open/mixed corridor to reach open ground - distance counts sections, not tiles

seal.name: no_open_reachable
seal._why: pure-interior neighbourhood with only unresolved ground: no seal exists - honest absence, the doctrine stays with the printed explain line

seal.name: self_loop_skipped
seal._why: a self-edge never seals the target onto itself (the target is the banned room, visited from the start)
